edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC3 Caller without the Treatment and offer right is refused (X2)
    Given the rwb-access contract mock returns the Treatment and offer right U refused for "RW-CASEOWN"
    When the caller submits the route operation
    Then the answer is 403 with MSG-P4-002 before any read or write
    Then no record is written

  Scenario: AC4 Stale data product refuses the start and names the product and its date (X3, BR12)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock returns a product of the source with a yesterday date and its ACE batch not arrived
    When the route start is composed
    Then the start is refused with MSG-P1-001 naming the product and its date
    Then nothing is created

  Scenario: AC5 Rule row in force with no to state holds the step (X4, BR1)
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock returns the rule row in force for route "R4" with no to state
    When the route start is composed
    Then the step is held and the parent is told
    Then nothing is written except the reason on the decision record

  Scenario: AC6 Task code, timer type or duration that is not a governed row refuses the start (X9, BR2)
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock returns no governed task or timer row for route "R4"
    When the route start is composed
    Then the step refuses the start and names the missing row
    Then no value is defaulted

  Scenario: AC7 Case not in an approved state or route already open starts nothing (X5, BR7)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns a case state that is not approved for "RC-2026-000412"
    When the route start is requested
    Then the answer says "nothing to start"
    Then no second flow begins and the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC8 rwb-case does not answer inside 2 s and the step waits (X6)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer inside 2 s
    When the route start is requested
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's own schedule
    Then nothing is written and the caller sees 503 in the platform envelope

  Scenario: AC9 Same command submitted twice with the same Idempotency-Key starts one route (X7, BR17)
    Given the same command is submitted twice with the same `Idempotency-Key`
    When the second command arrives
    Then one record, one answer and one route start exist
    Then the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC10 Statement on another schema or a v_ace view is refused and fails the build (X8, BR4, BR8)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches a `recovery_case`, `task` or `timer` row, a `v_ace_*` view or another service's schema
    When the grant and the boundary test run
    Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build
    Then nothing is released
